'''Stepheden Thaldree''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an [[officer]] of the [[Canto Bight Police Department]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. He wore a light [[Color|blue]] uniform [[Clothing|tunic]] with black stripes on the [[Limb|arms]] and a [[betaplast]] [[armor]]ed collar as well as a pair of blue pants, a white [[belt]] and black highly polished [[synth-hide]] officer's [[boot]]s. As an officer of the law, he was equipped with a short-ranged wrist [[comlink]], a scrambled long-range comlink, an [[electro-shock prod]], a [[police glow rod]] and two [[Relby K-25 blaster|K-25 blasters]], one of which he used in heavy configuration. Thaldree had fair skin and brown [[eye]]s and [[hair]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stepheden Thaldree first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
